hints.title: Subtree Flip Aggregation
hints.text: Count how many times each node v is chosen as the root of a flip operation.

hints.title: Top-Down Flip Propagation
hints.text: In a binary heap tree, child nodes are 2 * v and 2 * v + 1. Propagate accumulated flips from parent to children.

hints.title: Value One Parity
hints.text: A node ends with value 1 if and only if its cumulative flip count is odd.

hints.title: Top-Down Flip Propagation Implementation

variables: n: number of nodes in binary tree
complexity.notes: Query frequency aggregation followed by linear top-down flip propagation.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Traversing subtrees for each query individually takes O(queries * n) time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Array of size n + 1 stores parity states.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Propagates flips top-down from parent i // 2 in single pass.
